functionsSource.Hisense_GetDeviceInfo:
function() {
        console.log('go to Hisense_GetDeviceInfo')
        var info = {
            chipset: Hisense_GetChipSetName(),
            software_version: Hisense_GetFirmWareVersion(),
            os_version: 'VIDAA ' + Hisense_GetOSVersion(),
            api_version: Hisense_GetApiVersion(),
            runtime_version: 'Chromium ' + Hisense_GetChromiumVersion(),
            brand: Hisense_GetBrand(),
            uuid: Hisense_GetUuid(),
            region: Hisense_GetRegion(),
            capability_code: Hisense_GetCapabilityCode(),
            feature_code: Hisense_GetFeatureCode(),
            model_name: Hisense_GetModelName()
        }
        return info
    }
